description: Check the wash-traffic / organic-revenue risk of an Algorand x402 endpoint before trusting or paying it. Returns a risk level (low/medium/high/critical), a 0-100 score, and the specific on-chain red flags (few distinct payers, self-dealing payout loops, freshly-created wallets, metronomic timing). Free quick check via the hosted Provenance API.

address.description: The Algorand endpoint payTo address (58 characters, A-Z and 2-7)
